# Dutiyagāthāsaṅgaṇika (Pvr 19)

**ID:** Pvr 19
**Section:** Parivāra (pvr)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Dutiyagāthāsaṅgaṇika
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m4.mul15.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dutiyagāthāsaṅgaṇika* ("Verses on offenses, training rules, and legal procedures", Pvr 19) is the nineteenth chapter of the *Parivāra* in the Vinaya Piṭaka. It presents Vinaya material in the form of verse questions and answers, addressing specific offense categories and conditions—such as offenses tied to the rising of dawn, including *nissaggiya pācittiya* and *saṅghādisesa* [Bapat and Hirakawa 1970]. An English translation is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

The text is expounded in the Vinaya commentary, the *Samantapāsādikā* (including its Chinese version, the *Shan-Chien-P'i-P'o-Sha*), which comments on its verses and analytical question-and-answer structure [Bapat and Hirakawa 1970].
